reason: I like that it looks modern and the cash-drawer check is useful, but ₹4,999 upfront plus ₹999 every month is a fixed cost I pay even in slow months, before I know my staff will actually use it on busy Sundays.
objection: Paying ₹4,999 setup before seeing it work, then ₹999 every month whether the month is good or slow. If my stylists don't bother with the selfie and billing on a rush day, I've paid for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee, or the setup refunded if I cancel after the free month, so I only start paying once I've seen my staff use it through one busy festival week.
